websites.title: Websites to check
websites.description: One line per website: a domain (apify.com) or a full URL (https://apify.com/contact). A comma or newline separated string works too. Duplicates are dropped by host: one site, one crawl, one event. A site with no contacts is reported with the reason instead of disappearing.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Max pages per website
maxPagesPerSite.description: How deep to look. Page 1 is always the address you gave; the rest go to contact/about/imprint/support/privacy pages found on it. More pages = more chances to find a hidden email, and a little more run time.

includeSocials.title: Collect social profiles
includeSocials.description: LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, GitHub, TikTok, Telegram, Threads - only the ones actually linked on the site.

includeAddress.title: Collect postal address
includeAddress.description: Take the company address from the site's schema.org markup (JSON-LD). Empty when the site does not publish one - nothing is filled in from a guess.

cacheMinutes.title: Reuse a recent answer (minutes)
cacheMinutes.description: A repeated run for the same site inside this window is served from cache: no second crawl, no wasted time. 0 turns the cache off.

concurrency.title: Sites in parallel
concurrency.description: How many websites are crawled at the same time. 8 is a good default; raise it only for large lists.
